findings.title: Claim form amount does not match hospital bill total plus pharmacy bill
findings.detail: The amount claimed on the claim form does not equal the sum of the hospital total payable and the pharmacy invoice total.

findings.title: Billed investigation lacks a corresponding report
findings.detail: Investigation Charges of 2213.75 are billed on the final bill, but no matching lab report or investigation result is found in the file.

findings.title: Billed laboratory reports not mentioned in clinical record narrative
findings.detail: Complete Blood Count and Serum Electrolytes reports are present in the file, but are not mentioned in the clinical course narrative of the discharge summary.

findings.title: Pharmacy bill items not supported by discharge prescription
findings.detail: Medicines purchased from the outside pharmacy have no corresponding prescription in the file matching the outside pharmacy bill date and invoice.

findings.title: Claim form admission date format differs from internal documents
findings.detail: The admission date on the claim form is formatted as DD/MM/YYYY whereas hospital records use DD Mon YYYY.
